The changed declaration is `useVisit` in `openmrs-esm-core`, defined at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:52`. The patient chart reaches it through `@openmrs/esm-framework`, so none of its call sites import it by path. I found 12 non-test call sites in the chart checkout, plus one hook that imports it without calling it. Each call site uses the returned `activeVisit`, `mutate`, or `isLoading`, so a change to the return shape, the active-visit rule, or the SWR revalidation behaviour would reach all of them.

**Confirmed call sites (best first)**

1. `esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts:85-94`, in `usePatientChartPatientAndVisit`. Calls `useVisit(isVisitContextValid ? null : patientUuid)` and uses `activeVisit`, `isValidating`, and `mutate` to set the chart's visit context on entry. This is the most sensitive use, since it decides which visit becomes the chart's context.
2. `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.modal.tsx:22`. Uses `activeVisit` and `mutate` to end the visit and refresh it afterwards.
3. `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/visit-form.workspace.tsx:37`. Uses `mutate` as `mutateActiveVisit` after saving a visit.
4. `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/exported-visit-form.workspace.tsx:135`. Uses `activeVisit` and `isLoading`.
5. `esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.component.tsx:18`. Uses `activeVisit` to decide whether to show the stop-visit action.
6. `esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/delete-visit.component.tsx:18`. Uses `activeVisit` to gate the delete-visit action.
7. `esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-banner-tags/visit-attribute-tags.extension.tsx:37`. Uses `activeVisit` to render visit attribute tags in the banner.
8. `esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx:14`. Uses `activeVisit` and `isLoading` to render the visit tag in the banner.

**Likely affected, but not verified**

- `esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/visit-mutations.ts:3`. Imports `useVisit` alongside `restBaseUrl`, but the grep found no call in the lines I read, so it may be an unused import. I read only the first 20 lines of this file, so a call further down would not have shown in the grep.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts:63` and `esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/revalidation-utils.ts:9,87` mention `useVisit` only in comments. They would need updating if the hook's behaviour changes, but they are not callers.

**Test mocks (affected only if mock shapes change)**

The chart test files mock `useVisit` with `vi.mocked` and cast to `ReturnType<typeof useVisit>`. These include `esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.test.tsx`, `delete-visit.test.tsx`, `visit-attribute-tags.test.tsx`, `visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.test.tsx`, `visit/visit-form/visit-form.test.tsx`, `patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.test.ts`, `esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.test.tsx`, and `esm-patient-vitals-app/.../vitals-header.test.tsx`. These would start failing only if the return type changes.

**Not checked**

- I searched only the local chart checkout for chart usage. Other openmrs repositories that use `useVisit` were out of scope for this question.
- Falkon's symbol tools did not resolve the short repo name `openmrs-esm-core`. I used the full name `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core` to get results.
- The core hook reads `useVisitContextStore`, and I did not check how `setVisitContext` and the store interact with its revalidation logic, so the revalidation path is only partly traced.
